context: Reference coverage for short-circuit permission lookup, IntStream.range mapToObj, BigDecimal reduce, and primitive DoubleStream sum.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates StreamHelpers.java with requested methods and nested types.

checklist.name: Uses short-circuit permission lookup
checklist.description: Checks permissions with a stream shape that short-circuits, such as flatMap(...).anyMatch(...), nested anyMatch/contains, or flatMap(...).filter(...).findAny().orElseThrow(...) when it preserves the same behavior clearly.

checklist.name: Uses IntStream range mapping
checklist.description: Creates orders with IntStream.range(0, 50).mapToObj(...) or equivalent range stream.

checklist.name: Uses reduce for BigDecimal
checklist.description: Sums order totals with map(Order::totalAmount).reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add) or equivalent immutable reduction.

checklist.name: Uses primitive sum for radii
checklist.description: Filters/casts Circle values safely and uses mapToDouble(Circle::radius).sum(), not boxed reduce.
